verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents an issuing product with custom authorization flows and accept/reject logic, so a sandbox simulator for transaction lifecycles is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence mentions a sandbox, test environment, or the ability to simulate authorizations, clearings, reversals, refunds, or declines. The authorization-control features are related but different capabilities, and the breach discussion is off-topic.

support.subject: As a developer, I can simulate the whole transaction lifecycle in the sandbox — authorizations, clearings, reversals, refunds, and declines — so my auth logic is tested before a real card ever swipes
